task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Time Off module in Odoo.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the Odoo dashboard and then transitions to the 'Time Off' module interface.

task_completion.description: Agent filters or identifies leave requests in 'To Submit' (Draft) status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'To Submit' filter applied in the search bar or see the agent looking at records with the status 'To Submit'.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies specific requests with a Start Date before the current date.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent hovers over or selects records where the 'Start Date' column shows a date in the past relative to the current system date.

task_completion.description: Agent selects only the stale draft requests, excluding future drafts or non-draft statuses.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Checkboxes are ticked next to records that are both 'To Submit' and have past dates. Future dates or 'Approved/Refused' statuses remain unselected.

task_completion.description: Agent uses the Action menu to delete the selected records.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks 'Action' and then 'Delete', followed by a confirmation dialog appearing and being accepted.

integrity.description: The agent performed the task via the Odoo web interface rather than using a terminal or script.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and menu navigation within the browser, not a command-line interface.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the UI rather than guessing record IDs in the URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent clicks on buttons and filters within the Odoo UI to find the records.

integrity.description: The agent actually deletes the records rather than just closing the tab or claiming it's done.
integrity.visual_evidence: The deletion confirmation popup is visible and the records disappear from the list view after the action.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must delete exactly 3 records. These records are in 'To Submit' (Draft) status and have start dates in the past (specifically -30, -15, and -5 days from today). There are 2 other draft records with future dates (+10, +20 days) and 4 records in other statuses (Approved/Confirmed) that MUST NOT be deleted. The system date can be seen in the Odoo interface or the environment clock.
